messages:
maria: Idea: offer an ephemeral 'rollback token' when applying runtime config + an opt-in preview that routes a tiny shadow sample so teams can see real telemetry before committing.

teju: Short-lived token sounds good. How short? 30-60m seems reasonable for fast human rollback.

maria: Thinking TTL default 1h but configurable per-org. Token is a signed blob containing commit_id + change_hash + expiry.

owen: Preview needs isolation. Shadow traffic must be labeled and use exact batching/cache paths so p95 and cache-hit metrics are meaningful.

ravi: We should also return sim_metrics from preview: expected token_cost_delta, p50/p95 latency shift, error delta, kv_cache_hit_rate delta, and sample size. Show confidence intervals.

teju: API sketch: POST /v1/runtime/configs/apply {changes, preview:true, shadow_sample:0.001} -> {preview_id, sim_metrics}. Commit with request_rollback_token -> {commit_id, rollback_token, ttl_secs}. Revert via POST /v1/runtime/configs/revert {rollback_token}.

maria: Auditing: issuance and usage must write audit events linking user -> commit -> token -> revert. Also key rotation and KMS signing required.

owen: UX: console shows a countdown for the token, simulated vs prod metrics side-by-side, and a one-click revert while token is valid. Warn if overlapping commits make revert partial.

ravi: Automations: allow a telemetry-gate that auto-uses the token to revert if metric drift exceeds threshold in X minutes. But make this opt-in and explicit.

maria: Limits: default shadow_sample 0.1%, tenant sandbox quota cap, and preview caching for repeat dry-runs keyed by changeset_hash + model_version to reduce load.

opsbot: deploy-bot: shadow-simulator v0.9 rolled to staging at 2026-03-10T11:02:00Z :white_check_mark:

teju: Next steps: quick RFC with API proto + console mocks, small server prototype for token issuance + revert endpoint, and a demo on an internal service.
maria: I'll draft RFC and ping reviewers. Thanks! :rocket:
